steps: Read the score explainer and the Why? link
Probed the All orders menu, the target dropdown, a Call meeting, the map order panel with chances and Forecast
Approved staff picks and executed 12 months, read the Table view each month
scenarios.notes: Only 12 of 120 months played, so I can state some rules (score drift, capital, order effects) but not the long game.

steps: Found the staff re-adding 'Mobilize forces' every month at 100% mobilization, costing stability for nothing
Could not run controlled tests with the country picker
scenarios.notes: I saw one repeated move that is bad, not one that wins. Not enough months to say whether a dominant strategy exists.

friction.expected: Know what the dots next to nations mean
friction.happened: Dots (one to three) next to each nation have no label; I guessed difficulty. Tough nations are the three-dot ones, but not said
The only goal is 'Survive to the end of your term'. My round-1 complaint (nothing to optimise) is still there on day one
Staff had pre-spent 2 of my 3 seals on Mobilize forces and Court Poland before I touched anything; I had to find the small X to get them back

friction.where: All orders, Pick a country and the Target dropdown
friction.expected: Choose Ukraine and order a ceasefire
friction.happened: The Target control is a plain native dropdown with bracketed numbers (relations score, unexplained). Typing 'Ukr' + Enter did not select it. Two blocks, so I dropped to the Call meeting route
'Staff would answer: Offer talks on a ceasefire' pill overlaps the Foreign Minister text and a 'Send a deputy' button is cut off at the right edge
Cards show direction only (Approval up, Economy down, +1 more) with no magnitudes before I commit. The numbers only appear after Execute

friction.where: Month 1 result, Demand a full withdrawal
friction.happened: 'President Zelensky listens, and promises nothing' with Tension 74 to 73 (the card said Tension would go up). The card forecast and the result disagree and I got no reason
Poland's view of you fell -80 to -92 while mine rose -80 to -73; the order was labelled Court. Fine if intended but no rule shown

friction.where: Result card, the 'Why?' link and chips
friction.happened: Click by label on Why? and on the chips did not register; tapping the chip by coordinates worked (maybe a driver issue)
Mobilization already 100 to 100 and each order cost stability (57 to 55) and capital; 'It is your 6th order of this kind' and still suggested. Looks like fake depth in the advisor
Forecast text runs under the bottom bar and the card is cut off

Camille Girard (President of France) I did not know; Tusk and Díaz-Canel I did. 'Seals', 'exhaustion 51%', 'Front 55/100', 'Intelligence on Turkey 73.8 to 95' and 'Reassure: no threat intended' are not defined; the bracket numbers in the dropdown not either. Tusk as Poland PM I knew

bugs.title: Native Target dropdown does not accept typing in the All orders panel
bugs.expected: Ukraine selected and order buttons enabled

bugs.title: Cabinet pick pill overlaps text on a Call meeting
bugs.actual: Pill and Foreign Minister quote overlap, button cut off

bugs.title: Forecast contradicts result for Demand full withdrawal
bugs.expected: Tension up, Ukraine view down, as forecast
bugs.actual: Result 'listens and promises nothing', tension 74 to 73

bugs.title: Staff re-suggests Mobilize forces at 100% mobilization and it costs stability
steps: Approve all staff picks for 6 months
bugs.actual: Mobilization 100 to 100, stability 57 to 55, capital spent

suggestions.what: Show effect sizes (plus or minus N) on every order card, with the rule on tap
Replace the Target dropdown with a searchable country list that shows what the numbers mean
Give Legacy real goals beyond surviving (era targets, a ledger over 120 months)
Stop staff suggesting orders that cannot move anything, or say why they are still worth it
A rules page listing capital, caps (6 orders, one per target), and refusals in one place

delight: The month table with Reply and Numbers columns, every number with from and to (shots/dan-legacy/021-tbl.png)
Score tooltip and 'Why your score moved' with the 15 percent drift rule (shots/dan-legacy/009-score.png)
Map order panel with success chances and a plain reason when an order is refused (shots/dan-legacy/032-pol.png)
World drawer with fronts, exhaustion and alliance strengths (shots/dan-legacy/042-world.png)
Why-card line 'your choices +0, everything else -2' on approval (shots/dan-legacy/018-m1.png)

fun.reason: Reading why every number moved is satisfying, but 12 months of approve-and-execute was passive.

clarity.reason: The month table and score explainer answer why numbers moved, which is my top need.

visual.reason: Handsome map and cards; a few overlaps and clipped panels.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Staff auto-play means I could finish a month without a decision; the systems are there but not yet pulling me in.

agency.reason: Orders are explained but pre-filled by staff, the country picker blocked me, and the front moved against me after an order I could not see coming.

realism.reason: Real leaders, relations numbers, front and exhaustion feel plausible; Poland worsening after being courted looked odd.

replay.reason: I would try other eras if the 120 months had goals; today Legacy offers only survival.

recommend.reason: Best transparency I have seen in a game this accessible, but I cannot yet tell if depth is real or if one move wins.

verbatim: Finally a game that shows from-and-to numbers, but give me the sizes before I click and a goal bigger than survive.
